Flipkart's Data Science Team

Works on deciphering the richest possible data about Indian consumers, our vast product selection and proliferating seller-base to deliver holistic data-driven solutions across the Flipkart ecosystem. This team possesses the capability to design end-to-end solutions spanning across Supply Chain, Fintech, Consumer Experience, Search & Discovery, Demand Shaping, Fraud Modeling, Self-Healing Systems, and more.
